body.statement: Can the stratified active-set handle be made into a complete proof that, for every admissible \(\Sigma\) and every \(\sigma\), the retained family \(\{z_0,z_I:|I|\le2\}\) contains the unique minimizer of \(f\) over every nonempty \(H_{\sigma}\), including rank-deficient line and point sectors, and that the resulting \(J_{\sigma}\) and norm-equality branches are necessary and sufficient for legal strict-diffusion feasibility?
body.justification: This is the proof-boundary bottleneck: continuity from full-dimensional sectors does not settle strict or lower-dimensional equality branches.
body.gap: Neither the algebraic identifiability proof of DettlingHomsAmendolaDrtonHansen2023 nor the one-edge feasibility argument of vanSeeventerSalehkaleybar2026 proves this finite joint-sector certificate.
body.consumer: A positive resolution certifies every later phase-diagram, contact, and inference claim without numerical active-set assumptions.
